items.Sentence: The septic tanks at the existing areas will be replaced and a new “Visitor Contact Center” will be constructed.
New 6-inch PVC pipe will convey effluent from all three new septic tanks to a 20,000 gallon dosing tank for flow equalization.
The effluent will be discharged from the dosing tank into a new 3-acre leachfield southwest of the South Entrance Station
